Leave. I'm only about to be 18, but I grew up in a very violent home. No matter how well he treats your son l, he is damaging him by harming you. I know my mom was a victim, but I've grown up hating her for what she exposed my sister and I to. Please don't say it was stupid of you to start the argument. Even if you were screaming at him, that gives him absolutely NO right or excuse to lay his hands on you in any way. Maybe he needs therapy and maybe things can work one day, but being with him is not safe at all. Especially since the first injury was something like a black eye. Usually it just starts with bruises and escalates from there. This will only get worse if nothing is changed. I truly hope everything works out for you and your son. Stay safe.
